items.title: この・その・あの + noun
items.pattern: この N / その N / あの N
items.explanation: These modifiers need a following noun. この points near the speaker, その near the listener, あの away from both; compare standalone これ/それ/あれ.

items.title: と joining nouns
items.explanation: Joins the named nouns, as in りんごと水. Later companion と has a different role.

items.title: に for a clock time
items.explanation: Marks a specified clock time, as 九時に行きます. Destination に may also occur in the same sentence; identify each noun's role.

items.title: から・まで: from/until
items.pattern: start から end まで
items.explanation: Marks the start and endpoint of the stated range. 九時半から十時まで is nine thirty until ten; an endpoint is not a duration number by itself.

items.title: General item counter つ
items.explanation: Use ひとつ, ふたつ, みっつ, よっつ, いつつ, むっつ, ななつ, やっつ, ここのつ, とお. Do not construct じゅうつ. いくつ asks the quantity.

items.title: People counter 人
items.explanation: The first two are ひとり and ふたり; 三人 is さんにん. Things counted with 二つ differ from people counted with 二人.

items.title: どれ versus どの
items.explanation: どれ stands alone as which one; どの modifies a noun. Do not put a noun directly after どれ.

items.title: Entering and leaving
items.pattern: 店に入ります / 店を出ます
items.explanation: に marks the entered destination with 入る; を marks the place left with 出る, distinct from an ordinary consumed object.
